newsitem.title: USA: American Management stock tumbles on earnings warning.
newsitem.headline: American Management stock tumbles on earnings warning.

text.p: The stock of American Management Systems Inc. lost more than 17 percent of its value Monday after the business consulting firm warned that fourth-quarter and 1996 earnings will be less than previously forecast due to a delay in completing a large project.
The company's stock fell $5.625 to $26.25 on the Nasdaq market.
American Management said it will report 1996 earnings of between 81 to 85 cents a share, compared with analysts' expectations of profits of 93 cents.
It did not identify the project or provide further details and company officials could not be reached for further comment.
